fallbacks.subagents: Sequential fresh-context review using the exact base..head package; report degraded independence.
fallbacks.web_access: Require supplied source material and record Unknown rather than guessing.
fallbacks.browser_verification: Use command-line evidence and record rendered-UI verification as Not Run.
fallbacks.human_approval_gates: Halt and require an explicit human reply.

supported_runtime_versions: Any LLM agent with file read, write, edit, and command execution
install: Provide BOOTSTRAP.md at the start of every session.
uninstall: Stop providing the file. Nothing is installed.
rollback: Provide the prior tagged Kernel file.
limitations: No native activation mechanism exists, so this is Manual by definition. If command execution is unavailable, the runtime is Unsupported.
